name: FP-LAD
summary: FP-LAD, also known as fluoro-PRO-LAD, PROF-LAD, or TRALA-16, is a serotonin receptor modulator of the lysergamide family related to lysergic acid diethylamide (LSD; METH-LAD). It is specifically a fluorinated derivative of PRO-LAD (6-propyl-6-nor-LSD) and an analogue of FLUORETH-LAD (FE-LAD; 6-ethyl-6-nor-LSD).

pharmacology.text: FP-LAD, also known as fluoro-PRO-LAD, PROF-LAD, or TRALA-16, is a serotonin receptor modulator of the lysergamide family related to lysergic acid diethylamide (LSD; METH-LAD). The drug has been reported to act as a potent ligand of the serotonin 5-HT2 receptors. It had affinities (Ki) of 0.93 nM at the serotonin 5-HT2A receptor, 1.8 nM at the serotonin 5-HT2B receptor, and 3.7 nM at the serotonin 5-HT2C receptor.
pharmacology.kind: Serotonin receptor modulator; Serotonin 5-HT2A receptor agonist

uses.text: FP-LAD was patented by Daniel Trachsel and Matthias Liechti and colleagues in association with MindMed (Mind Medicine) in 2023.
